[![Binder](https://mybinder.org/badge_logo.svg)](https://mybinder.org/v2/gh/SofiaBillBerg/code_agent.git/HEAD)  

> A lightweight, LLM-driven assistant that can scaffold projects, edit files, generate documentation, and operate as an interactive chatbot.

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies (uv is recommended)
uv venv .venv  
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .[dev]  # Include dev extras for development tools  

# Run the CLI agent directly
code-agent help
```

You can now type queries, e.g.:
> Show me a simple project scaffold  
> Add a new function to utils.py  

## Architecture Overview

The `code_agent` package uses an OAP-inspired capability layer with hash-chained audit logs for security. All tools inherit from LangChain's [`BaseTool`](https://python.langchain.com/docs/concepts/#base-tool).

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  CLI[Typer CLI] --> Main[Main Driver/LLM Wrapper]  
  Main --\u003e Graph[LangGraph StateGraph (deprecated)] 
    subgraph "Agent Core"
      Graph[LGraph Orchestrator]
      Tools[[BaseTool Registry]]
      Memory[(ChromaDB Vector Store)]
    end
  
  CLI --> Chat[Interactive Loop/CLI Commands]  
  Main --\u003e Providers[LLM Provider Layer (Ollama/OpenAI)] 
```

**Key Design Patterns:**
- **Capability-Based Security**: All tool invocations are audited with cryptographic receipts before execution.
- **Backend-Agnostic LLM Abstraction**: Swap between Ollama, OpenAI, or any LangChain-compatible model without changing agent logic.  
- **Atomic File Operations**: Write/read/edit operations support rollback via diff tracking and audit logging.

## Features at a Glance

See [FEATURES](./FEATURES.qmd) for detailed capability lists:
- 🏗️ Project scaffolding with `scaffold` command (generates src/, tests/, docs/)  
- ✍️ File manipulation tools (create, read, edit, delete via agent or Python API)  
- 🔧 Extensible toolset (search-explain, generate-test, format-code, etc.)  
- 🤖 Interactive chatbot with context-aware responses  

## Public API

The package exports these main functions from [`code_agent/__init__.py`](../src/code_agent):

```python
from code_agent import (  # Core agent building & orchestration
    build_agent, create_default_tools, 
    write_file, read_file, edit_file, append_file,  # File operations  
    py_to_ipynb, create_from_template,               # Template utilities
    
    load_config, create_llm,                        # LLM management
    
    CapabilityRegistry, tool_to_capability,         # OAP capability layer
)

config = load_config()  
llm = create_llm(config)  # Default: ChatOllama + GPT4AllEmbeddings
agent_runnable = build_agent(llm=llm, tools=create_default_tools())
```

See [API Reference](./API.qmd) for complete documentation.  

## Installation & Setup

For a full guide with configuration options, see [QUICKSTART](./QUICKSTART.qmd). Briefly:

1. **Prerequisites**: Python 3.10+, Ollama running locally (or OpenAI API key), `uv` package manager
2. Pull model: `ollama pull llama3`  
3. Configure `.env`: Set `OLLAMA_MODEL=llama3`, etc.  
4. Run agent: `code-agent chat` or use Python API
